notes:
- New Create > Create Tasks: add task folders to existing assets/shots
- Create Workspaces now adds workspaces only, with an 'Add to' row to pick which existing tasks get them
- Create Asset Folders / Create Shot Folders: workspaces removed (use Create Workspaces); cleaner layout
- Open / Save As: Task / Name switch now sits next to Hide checked; Refresh back in the centre
- Open / Save As: tasks can be hidden per asset/shot, or a whole task for a type
- Fix: drag-to-reorder no longer makes the dragged row disappear
- Project > Select Project Folder (was Set Project Parent Folder): pick your project, or any folder inside it, and it becomes current; the projects folder is worked out for you
- Open / Save As: tick assets or shots and use Hide checked to tidy the list; drag to reorder assets and types (right-click > Reset order)
- Open: other Maya files in the folder show under an 'Outside pipeline' line; tick files + Hide checked to hide them
- Texture Connect works on any selection, not just referenced Shade assets, with an Asset picker
- Utility > Load Textures: UV tile previews on + textured viewports in one click
- Thumbnails: Grab any rectangle; thumbnails keep their shape and fit the box
- Personal view settings are saved per user in <project>/project settings/<username>.json
